name: services-demo
description: AppPort Services example application demonstrating API Keys, Webhooks, and Jobs

scripts.demo:create-key: npm run build && node dist/cli.js api-key create --tenant demo-tenant --name default --scope invoices.write --created-by demo-operator
scripts.demo:create-invoice: npm run build && node dist/cli.js invoice create --tenant demo-tenant --customer acme-corp --amount 1000
scripts.demo:list-invoices: npm run build && node dist/cli.js invoice list --tenant demo-tenant
